name: completion-tapd-portable-pack
description: Impact analysis, minimal self-test, TAPD backfill — portable rules & skills

usage.bundleRoot: Copy entire temp/ folder anywhere; keep rules/ and skills/ as siblings.
usage.config: Copy tapd.config.example.json to project workspace as tapd.config.json (or merge tapd key into your own config).
usage.skills: Register skills/ paths in your agent (Cursor Rules point to rules/; load skills/ on demand).
